title: axR: Interfacing and Retrieving Data from Accelerometer Devices
description: Serial communication and data retrieval for Axivity AX3/AX6 accelerometer devices: device discovery, status, settings, data download, and reading recorded .cwa/AX6 binary files. Wraps the Open Movement Project's OMAPI C library rather than reimplementing the serial protocol or binary file format directly. Also reads Condor Instruments ActTrust .txt actigraphy exports into the same tidy epoch shape, as a device-agnostic actigraphy import layer. Part of the Circadia Lab R ecosystem.
